children: SalMar ASA (rated BBB by Nordic Credit Rating) has today, 10 September 2026, issued two new commercial papers, with a nominal amount of NOK 1,000 million and NOK 250 million, both papers have an issue date of 15 September 2026 and maturity date of 15 September 2027.
Nominal amount: NOK 1,000 million, with a limit of NOK 1,500 million
Nominal amount: NOK 250 million, with a limit of NOK 500 million
This information is subject to the disclosure requirements stipulated in section 5-12 of the Norwegian Securities Trading Act.

title: SalMar - Issuance of Commercial Papers
